description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the identification, registration, and management of roads and paths that are deemed to be vested in Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies).
